title: Authorization code with mandatory PKCE and audience-bound access tokens (RFC 7636, RFC 8707)
description: The one grant for anything that can host a redirect: authorization code with PKCE (RFC 7636) required, no implicit grant, no password grant. The access token's audience is the provider's JMAP endpoint, requested with RFC 8707 resource indicators, so a token minted for mimid is not usable anywhere else and a Google token is never accepted in its place. Includes how the token is checked on each request, beside today's `mimid admin ... token` bearer tokens, which do not go away.
